overall_notes:
Vendor quoted all 30 RFx lines (quotation rows 11-46 map 1:1 to L01-L30). Key points for evaluation:
(1) MIXED PRICE UNITS - L01, L02, L27, L18 and L19 are quoted per 100 Nos; L21 and L22 are quoted per Kg (not per roll); all others per piece / per set. No conversion has been applied here.
(2) PRICE BASIS is EX-WORKS Vasai, not delivered Bhiwandi as requested. Free delivery only for full truck loads with min 3 MT per drop; part-load freight cost not quoted.
(3) COMMERCIAL DEVIATIONS: payment 30 days from invoice (vs 45 days from receipt); validity 30 days (vs 180 required); kraft paper price-variation clause +/- 5% band; qty tolerance +/- 10%; plate/die charge Rs 4,500 per design extra (applies to the 1-colour, 2-colour and 4-colour printed lines L03, L04, L05, L06, L07, L08, L13, L14, L15, L16, L24, L25, L26).
(4) ROLLS (L21/L22): quoted Rs 40.50/Kg with vendor-assumed weights (44,100 kg for 3,000 rolls = 14.7 kg/roll; 35,280 kg for 2,000 rolls = 17.64 kg/roll) and 'actual weight will be billed' - per-roll landed cost is not firm.
(5) ARITHMETIC ANOMALY on L14 (PKG-10042): rate 13.35 x 150,000 = 1,002,500... actually 2,002,500, but vendor's amount column shows 2,160,000 (implying 14.40/pc). Confirmation needed.
(6) Three rows (quotation Sr. 7, 12, 22 and Sr. 24) carry no buyer code; matched on full specification and quantity - see individual match_reason.
(7) Mailer/tray spec details (E-flute white kraft top liner, roll-end tuck-front, tear-off front) and partition heights are not explicitly confirmed in the vendor descriptions.
(8) Q02 capacity 420 MT/m (meets >=300), Q04 lead time 7 days (meets <=10), Q06 moisture max 8% (meets <=9%), Q03 lab YES, Q01 ISO valid to 13-Feb-2028 - all technical criteria met.
